content: We choose Pointer Generator (Pointer-Gen) BIBREF0, a widely used summarization model, as our headline generator for its ability to copy words from the input article. It takes a news article as input and generates a headline. Firstly, the tokens of each article, $\lbrace x_1,x_2,x_3,\cdots ,x_M\rbrace $, are fed into the encoder one-by-one and the encoder generates a sequence of hidden states $h_i$. For each decoding step $t$, the decoder receives the embedding for each token of a headline $y_t$ as input and updates its hidden states $s_t$. An attention mechanism following luong2015effective is used:
